Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=rate-limiter-prod (PD-8917). Trigger: 429_throughput_threshold. Regions: us-west-2, eu-central-1. Severity: P1. Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8917
PagerDuty: Notifying escalation policy 'prod-infra'. Initial page sent to Alex M, Sam (oncall-2).
Alex M: ack
Alex M: I'm on it, looking at dashboards now - 429s spiked ~03:22 UTC, error rate ~18% for text-generation-route.
Priya G: seeing loads of `QuotaExceeded` on customer_x and some internal synthetic traffic. Could be a quota mapping bug.
Miguel S: I pulled recent deploys to rate-limiter-prod: there was a config push 2026-03-14T03:10Z from CI -> feature/rl-quota-rewrite (commit abc1234).
Alex M: running quick check: `kubectl -n infra exec -it rate-limiter-prod-0 -- curl localhost:8080/metrics | grep 429`
Alex M: logs show `quota_lookup failed: missing_key -> returning 429` repeatedly. stacktrace points to `quota-service` rpc returning 500 intermittently.
Priya G: @Alex M can you grep for mapping table size? suspect new mapping changed key format.
Alex M: grabbing mapping file: `gsutil cat gs://redwood-configs/rl/production/quota_map.json | head -n 40` - looks like keys changed from `customer:org:region` -> `cust|org|reg` due to migration script.
Miguel S: ahhh, that explains it. New delimiter not recognized by matcher, results in missing entries -> default 429. Who deployed migration?
Priya G: CI shows migration ran as part of `feature/rl-quota-rewrite` pipeline at 03:09Z.
Alex M: mitigation options: 1) revert quota_map to previous version, 2) hotfix matcher to accept both delimiters, 3) temporarily route traffic to older limiter instance pool. Revert is fastest.
Jules (CS): any ETA? customers already reporting degraded generation. We've had 3 support tickets opening in last 20m. Need communication plan.
Alex M: rolling back quota_map now. `gsutil cp gs://redwood-configs/rl/production/quota_map.json gs://redwood-configs/rl/production/quota_map.json.broken_1771234567` then `gsutil cp gs://redwood-configs/rl/production/quota_map.json@{2026-03-14T02:50Z} gs://redwood-configs/rl/production/quota_map.json`
Alex M: applied revert. Triggering config reload on rate-limiter: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/rate-limiter-prod`
Miguel S: watching metrics: 429 rate decreasing in us-west-2. latency stable.
Priya G: verifying customer behavior: synthetic check for customer_x now returns 200.
Jules (CS): posting update to affected customers: "We've mitigated an issue causing transient throttling; full update to follow." :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8917 acknowledged by Alex M at 1771234572.
PagerDuty: Escalation halted — incident acknowledged.
Alex M: digging for root cause: migration script changed delimiter in mapping without compatibility. Will prepare rollback PR template and postmortem.
Sam (oncall-2): I'll take 4-hour watch. If anything regresses, page me. Leaving Slack handoff notes here.
Alex M: handoff to Sam: current state = mitigated (config revert), 429s back to baseline, monitoring alerts silenced. Next steps: pin rollback commit, add schema validation to migration, run canary for mapping change.
Miguel S: created quick fix branch to make matcher accept both `:` and `|` delimiters, but won't promote until postmortem.
Priya G: adding an alert tweak: add a pre-deploy check for quota_map key format equality.
Jules (CS): summarizing customer impact: ~3 customers reported ~1-2 minute throttling interruptions, estimated <0.05% of active calls in window. CS follow-up ticket created: CS-621.
Alex M: timeline note for incident postmortem: 03:09Z migration ran -> 03:22Z spike observed -> 03:28Z alert fired -> 03:30Z rollback initiated -> 03:34Z rollback complete -> 03:36Z traffic normalized.
Sam (oncall-2): I'll draft the incident page with timeline + known RCA and link to PRs. Assigning followups: infra#rl-schema-validation, eng-runtime#matcher-compat.
Jules (CS): I'll reach out to the customers in the next 30m with a concise summary and link to postmortem once available.
Alex M: adding followups to /incidents channel: - RCA doc (PR created) - Add e2e canary for quota mappings - Add schema validation hook to CI.
Miguel S: p.s. add test for backwards compatibility in matcher unit tests.
Alex M: closing PD-8917 in PagerDuty now that incident is mitigated.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-8917 status changed to Resolved by Alex M at 1771235095.
Incident Bot: Please remember to fill out the postmortem template: /docs/incidents/postmortems/template.
Sam (oncall-2): I'll own the postmortem write-up. Leaving this thread for records.
Jules (CS): thanks team. I'll update customer tickets when postmortem link is ready. :pray:
